# openclaw-eacces-baseline — bare .exists()/.stat()/.is_file()/.is_dir()/
# open() calls on a bot .openclaw path that are NOT guarded by
# try/except (PermissionError, OSError) and do NOT route through
# secret_config_perms.exists_or_unreachable(). On Linux/Py3.12 such a call
# RAISES PermissionError when the OC gateway clamps the .openclaw ACL mask
# to --- (the #3184 deploy-abort / W10-G daemon-crash class). Generated by
# `tools/openclaw-eacces-lint --all --update-baseline`. The lint BLOCKS any
# file that EXCEEDS its count, so this file may only ratchet DOWN: route the
# call through exists_or_unreachable() / a read_text()+cat fallback / an
# explicit except (PermissionError, OSError) -> rerun --update-baseline ->
# the number drops. Goal state: this file is empty.
